display.title: Episode 232: Saved by Miracle, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi asks 'Where do you think you're going?': every mitzvah brings us closer to Hashem. Then a boy says the Shema and a new serial begins about a Chassid falsely accused of theft.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens with a car ride that gets pulled over: 'Where do you think you're going?' We are always traveling, he explains, either toward Hashem through mitzvos or away from Him through an averah. The word mitzvah also means connection, and averah means crossing over to the wrong side; just weeks after Shavuos, the Aseres HaDibros remind us of the do's and don'ts. After the Hakochainik march, a young member of Tzivos Hashem who knows all twelve pesukim by heart leads the Shema. Story time begins a new serial, introduced on air as 'Through the Eyes of a Tzaddik'. Reb Boruch, an honest Chassid trusted by the local minister, is framed by a jealous, cruel man named Alex, who hides stolen railroad logs in his barn. Summoned to the minister's office for Tuesday, Reb Boruch goes to the Alter Rebbe, who smiles and tells him to come back next Sunday. Trusting the Rebbe, he decides not to go. The show ends with new entrants in the Sefer Torah contest and a reminder that this Shabbos is Shabbos Mevarchim Tammuz.
display.lesson: We are always moving: every mitzvah brings us closer to Hashem, and every averah pulls us away, so ask yourself each day which way you are going.

date.note: 'This Shabbos is Shabbos Mevarchim Chodesh Tammuz' (Shabbos 28 Sivan 5746 = 1986-07-05); Tuesday show before it. Weekly estimate was 1986-06-30.

advisories.note: A Jew is falsely accused and summoned by the Russian authorities; people who received such summonses were jailed or disappeared.
